article.hook: You keep bumping into the edges of what you know and wondering if there's more. The North Node in Sagittarius pulls us toward a wider view that doesn’t fit in your usual lanes.
article.lived: Over the next eighteen months, conversations stretch longer and questions get bigger. You’ll notice yourself or your circle chasing down stories that don’t just entertain but challenge the frame of reference. Institutions, teams, and social circles start testing their boundaries - debates flare about purpose and meaning, sometimes in public, sometimes in quiet corners where the future feels negotiable.
article.turn: The urge to expand can turn into bulldozing what’s already built. When bigger stories drown out the details or dismiss what’s proven, curiosity becomes impatience. The lesson is plain: a bigger view is useless if it erases the ground beneath your feet.
moves: Host a conversation where everyone must defend a belief they don’t hold.
Map out where your current commitments limit what you can learn next.
Challenge a long-held rule by asking why it exists now, not just because it always has.
